title.zh: 【香港金管局 EnsembleTX 实现代币化存款全天候结算，试验将扩至稳定币】
title.en: 【香港金管局 EnsembleTX 实现代币化存款全天候结算，试验将扩至稳定币】

current_state.zh: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority announced that its EnsembleTX project now supports round-the-clock real-value settlement of tokenized deposits, completed secondary-market trial trades in tokenized Exchange Fund Bills, will widen testing to regulated stablecoins, and launched a tConnect Launchpad with Cyberport to validate tokenization use cases.
current_state.en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority announced that its EnsembleTX project now supports round-the-clock real-value settlement of tokenized deposits, completed secondary-market trial trades in tokenized Exchange Fund Bills, will widen testing to regulated stablecoins, and launched a tConnect Launchpad with Cyberport to validate tokenization use cases.
